items.claim: Lerone Douglas has put together six consecutive knockout wins, including in LFA, Contender Series, and against Julian Erosa.
items.quote: So, now it's six consecutive knockouts in a row for Douglas.

items.claim: Lerone Douglas has improved his striking defense.
items.quote: He's better defensively now with his striking, and the dude hits so hard at 145.

items.claim: Lerone Douglas has been submitted twice in his career, against Shepe Mariscal in 2018 and in XFC in 2014.
items.quote: Leri on Douglas has been subbed twice in her career. Those come to Shepe Mariscal in 2018 and then in XFC in 2014.
